title: Expansion Of Universe
definition: The Expansion of the Universe is the continuous increase in the spatial distance between distant galaxies over time, driven by cosmic metric expansion rather than movement through space.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC CSE General Studies Paper III (Science & Technology - Space Technology, Astrophysics) and relevant for General Studies Paper I (Geophysical phenomena, History of the Universe).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Expansion Of Universe.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
